dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (Open COBOL) free-format source, part of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) by Vincent B Coen. Version comment references 'Open Cobol v3.00.00' and later GnuCOBOL 3.2. Uses >>source free directive and *> comments.
evidence: Migration to Open Cobol v3.00.00 in change log
GC 3.2 warning msgs in .27 change note

purpose.domain_detail: Sales ledger invoice data entry and maintenance for the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS). Handles invoice creation, credit notes, pro-formas, stock updates, VAT, and open-item file posting.
purpose.summary: This program is the invoice data entry and maintenance module (SL910) of the ACAS sales ledger system. It supports batch and immediate invoice printing, credit note processing, stock control integration, VAT handling, and posting to open-item and analysis files. It calls numerous sub-modules for stock audit, stock, sales, delivery, analysis, deleted invoice numbers, invoices, and OTM3 open-item file.

notable_features: 19 CALL statements to sub-modules (acas010-acas019, sl070, sl930, sl960 etc.)
107 PERFORM and 107 GOTO statements indicating complex procedural flow
REDEFINES used extensively for screen accept/display fields
Stock control integration with audit trail
Support for deleted invoice number reuse
GNU GPL v2 licensed open-source accounting system
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 2341 lines. All four COBOL divisions present. The program is a long-lived (1976-2023) production accounting system module with extensive change history. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS found; uses ISAM/FH file access via DAL calls. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial calculations.
